## About
Providence Automotive is a local, family-owned repair shop on Main St in Providence Village, serving drivers around Aubrey, Denton, Little Elm, Prosper, Celina, Frisco, Pilot Point and nearby communities.
We work on foreign and domestic vehicles, from a quick oil change to brake repair, suspension work, wheel alignment and engine diagnostics. We try to explain repairs clearly so you know what your car needs and why.
We also like to stay connected to the neighborhood and support local events. Drivers have given us a 4.9 rating across 579 Google reviews.

## Services
- Oil change, brake repair and suspension work: Everyday maintenance and repairs, from a simple oil change to brake repair and suspension work.
- Diagnostics: When something feels off with your car, diagnostics can help find the underlying cause.
- Tire installation and balancing: Help choosing tires for your vehicle and budget, plus installation, balancing and alignment.
- Wheel alignment: Alignment helps your car drive smoothly and your tires wear evenly.
- Foreign and domestic repair: We work on both domestic and foreign vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Give us a call at the shop to book an appointment or ask for a quote.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Providence Village, Aubrey, Denton, Little Elm, Prosper, Celina, Frisco, Pilot Point and surrounding areas.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Promotional financing for 6 months is available on purchases of $199 or more made with a Synchrony Car Care credit card.
